device_entry.description: 一种用于工业自动化的可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）或工业控制器，可通过 ADS 暴露内部变量与符号。在实验室中常用于设备联锁、顺序控制、I/O 信号采集、执行器控制以及过程状态监测。
device_entry.description_en: A programmable logic controller (PLC) or industrial controller used for industrial automation, exposing internal variables and symbols over ADS. In laboratory systems it is commonly used for equipment interlocks, sequence control, I/O acquisition, actuator control, and process-state monitoring.
